notes:
Account snapshot: mid/large FS company building enterprise search and customer support RAG layer. Heavy sensitivity to latency and regulatory controls; looking for a vector-DB strategy that balances cost vs tail-latency.

Scale and targets:
- Corpus: ~200M documents (mix of filings, transcripts, KB articles) -> target embedding count 250M+ after chunking.
- Indexing cadence: daily incremental + backfill of historical data (one-time heavy backfill ~200M docs).
- Performance SLOs: p95 retrieval+rerank < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for standard queries (no large context).
- Throughput target: sustained 1k QPS for search APIs during peak; batch/analytics windows up to 10k QPS for internal jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query (end-to-end retrieval + rerank) ~$0.01 - $0.03; procurement wants a forecasted 12-month unit cost model.

Architectural preferences & constraints:
- Prefer open connector options: pgvector for on-prem control, Pinecone or Elastic Cloud for managed options. Important: ability to switch backends without reindexing metadata or changing app layer.
- Require connector features: S3 -> vector DB bulk load, CDC/streaming ingestion (Kafka or Kinesis), per-tenant namespace scoping, server-side metadata filters, vector shard-awareness, and graceful backpressure on spikes.
- Hybrid retrieval plan: BM25 (Elastic) for broad recall + ANN candidate generation -> cross-encoder reranker for precision. Wants Redwood to support cross-encoder batching and efficient GPU-backed rerankers (prefer cheap small cross-encoders for latency-sensitive calls, larger models for offline precision scoring).
- Reranking workflow: candidate set sizes 50-200 -> cross-encoder rerank in batches; need KV-cache reuse for multi-turn dialogues.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass vendor security questionnaire (sent 2025-02-25). Requirements: SOC2, SSO (SAML), per-tenant KMS-backed encryption, audit logs retained 2 years, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Blocker: Legal requires confirmation that managed vector DB operators will not access PII in raw form. They prefer either private deployment or VPC peering + encrypted payloads at rest.

POC plan (agreed in workshop 2025-02-20):
- Scope: ingest 5M representative docs into a trial vector index (customer-provided subset), run 100k synthetic+real queries to measure recall/latency/cost.
- Tech matrix: compare Pinecone (managed), pgvector (RDS/managed PG), and Elastic ANN (on-prem/provisioned). Benchmarks: recall@10, MRR, p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k queries.
- Success criteria: recall delta <= 5% vs golden baseline AND p95 < 150ms AND cost projection within target band.
